name: Sierrah Williams

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Williams lists her occupation as registered dietitian nutritionist, with a background as a dietitian with the WIC program.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist Occupational Background: Dietitian with the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 38

positions.statement: Williams says she would support bold action to expand affordable, accessible, quality rural healthcare, including reproductive and mental health resources.
positions.excerpt: Expand affordable, accessible and quality rural healthcare for all, including access to reproductive and mental health resources.
